skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Apply knowledge to develop applications and information systems in real-world scenarios.
Analyze problems in the field of Information Technology, from customer requirements to system performance and security.
Evaluate the effectiveness and feasibility of IT solutions and propose optimization methods to improve system performance and reliability.
Proficient in applying skills to create effective solutions for real-world IT problems.
Effectively collaborate and work in teams to foster creativity and progress in solving complex problems.
Demonstrate communication and problem-solving skills in real-world environments through presentations and discussions.
Set specific goals, plan actions, and take necessary steps to achieve goals during the thesis project.
Take responsibility and make appropriate decisions at different stages of the project, including topic selection, data collection, analysis, and report completion.
Complete and professionally present the report, showcasing the student's self-learning and self-management skills during the research and project implementation.
